<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>The Yellow Oven | Artisanal Dessert Bar & Café • Ahmedabad</title>
  <meta name="description" content="The Yellow Oven is Ahmedabad's premier late-night dessert café in Bodakdev. Viral fire desserts, plated Callebaut creations, sourdough pizzas, and specialty coffee." />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,600&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    :root {
      --color-text: #3B331F;
      --color-primary: #D79E17;
      --color-secondary: #B5A58B;
      --color-bg: #DDD1BA;
      --color-bg-card: #ECE4D4;
      --color-bg-card-hover: #F4EFE6;
      --color-card-border: rgba(181, 165, 139, 0.45);
      --color-surface-white: #FCFAF6;
      --color-dark-hero: #252014;
      --color-dark-hero-surface: #302A1C;
      --color-pill-bg: rgba(215, 158, 23, 0.15);
      --font-serif: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
      --font-sans: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      --transition-smooth: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
      --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(59, 51, 31, 0.06);
      --shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgba(59, 51, 31, 0.10);
      --shadow-lg: 0 16px 36px rgba(59, 51, 31, 0.14);
      --radius-sm: 8px;
      --radius-md: 14px;
      --radius-lg: 22px;
      --radius-full: 9999px;
    }

    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      background-color: var(--color-bg);
      color: var(--color-text);
      line-height: 1.65;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    button {
      font-family: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: none;
      background: none;
    }

    .container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 1.5rem;
    }

    .section-eyebrow {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.15em;
      color: var(--color-primary);
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .section-eyebrow::before {
      content: '';
      width: 24px;
      height: 2px;
      background-color: var(--color-primary);
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.75rem);
      color: var(--color-text);
      line-height: 1.25;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .section-title .highlight {
      color: var(--color-primary);
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .section-desc {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--color-text);
      opacity: 0.9;
      max-width: 650px;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 0.85rem 1.8rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background-color: var(--color-primary);
      color: #231E12;
      border: 2px solid var(--color-primary);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(215, 158, 23, 0.35);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background-color: #C08C12;
      border-color: #C08C12;
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(215, 158, 23, 0.45);
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      background-color: transparent;
      color: var(--color-text);
      border: 2px solid var(--color-secondary);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background-color: var(--color-secondary);
      color: #231E12;
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .btn-hero-secondary {
      background-color: rgba(221, 209, 186, 0.15);
      color: #DDD1BA;
      border: 2px solid var(--color-secondary);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    }

    .btn-hero-secondary:hover {
      background-color: var(--color-secondary);
      color: #231E12;
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      padding: 0.35rem 0.85rem;
      font-size: 0.775rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      background-color: var(--color-pill-bg);
      color: var(--color-text);
      border: 1px solid rgba(215, 158, 23, 0.35);
    }

    /* =========================================================
       1. NAVBAR
       ========================================================= */
    .navbar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background-color: rgba(221, 209, 186, 0.94);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(181, 165, 139, 0.5);
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
    }

    .navbar.scrolled {
      background-color: rgba(221, 209, 186, 0.98);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .navbar-container {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0.9rem 1.5rem;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #D79E17, #B58410);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #231E12;
      box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(215, 158, 23, 0.4);
    }

    .logo-text {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
      color: var(--color-text);
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .logo-subtext {
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--color-primary);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 2rem;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .nav-link {
      font-size: 0.925rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--color-text);
      position: relative;
      padding: 0.25rem 0;
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
    }

    .nav-link::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 0%;
      height: 2px;
      background-color: var(--color-primary);
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
    }

    .nav-link:hover,
    .nav-link.active {
      color: var(--color-primary);
    }

    .nav-link:hover::after,
    .nav-link.active::after {
      width: 100%;
    }

    .nav-cta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .hamburger-btn {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-around;
      width: 32px;
      height: 26px;
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0;
      z-index: 1001;
    }

    .hamburger-btn span {
      width: 100%;
      height: 3px;
      background-color: var(--color-text);
      border-radius: 4px;
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
    }

    .hamburger-btn.active span:nth-child(1) {
      transform: rotate(45deg) translate(6px, 6px);
    }

    .hamburger-btn.active span:nth-child(2) {
      opacity: 0;
    }

    .hamburger-btn.active span:nth-child(3) {
      transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(6px, -6px);
    }

    .mobile-menu {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 65px;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      background-color: var(--color-bg);
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-secondary);
      padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      z-index: 999;
    }

    .mobile-menu.open {
      display: flex;
    }

    .mobile-menu .nav-link {
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      padding: 0.5rem 0;
      display: block;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       2. HERO SECTION
       ========================================================= */
    .hero-section {
      position: relative;
      background-color: var(--color-dark-hero);
      color: #DDD1BA;
      padding: 6rem 0 5rem;
      overflow: hidden;
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(circle at 85% 20%, rgba(215, 158, 23, 0.16) 0%, transparent 50%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 10% 80%, rgba(181, 165, 139, 0.12) 0%, transparent 45%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #252014 0%, #1A160D 100%);
    }

    .hero-texture {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      opacity: 0.04;
      background-image: radial-gradient(#DDD1BA 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 20px 20px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 0.8fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 3.5rem;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .hero-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.4rem 1rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      background: rgba(215, 158, 23, 0.16);
      border: 1px solid rgba(215, 158, 23, 0.4);
      color: var(--color-primary);
      font-size: 0.825rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .hero-pill .dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      background-color: #2ecc71;
      border-radius: 50%;
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px #2ecc71;
      animation: pulseGlow 2s infinite ease-in-out;
    }

    @keyframes pulseGlow {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(0.85); }
    }

    .hero-headline {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 4rem);
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #DDD1BA;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    .hero-headline span.accent {
      color: var(--color-primary);
      font-style: italic;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .hero-subheadline {
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: #C5BAA5;
      margin-bottom: 2.25rem;
      max-width: 540px;
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    }

    .hero-stats {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 2rem;
      padding-top: 1.75rem;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(181, 165, 139, 0.25);
    }

    .hero-stat-item {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .hero-stat-val {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--color-primary);
    }

    .hero-stat-lbl {
      font-size: 0.775rem;
      color: #A99E89;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }

    .hero-card-visual {
      position: relative;
    }

    .hero-showcase-box {
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, #302A1C, #211B10);
      border: 1px solid rgba(215, 158, 23, 0.3);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 2rem;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
      position: relative;
    }

    .hero-showcase-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    .featured-label {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--color-primary);
      background: rgba(215, 158, 23, 0.12);
      padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    }

    .hero-showcase-title {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      color: #DDD1BA;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }

    .hero-showcase-desc {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: #B5A58B;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .hero-dessert-visual {
      width: 100%;
      height: 200px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: radial-gradient(circle, #524328 0%, #2A2213 100%);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px dashed rgba(215, 158, 23, 0.4);
    }

    .hero-flame-icon {
      font-size: 3.5rem;
      animation: flicker 1.8s infinite ease-in-out alternate;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(215, 158, 23, 0.8));
    }

    @keyframes flicker {
      0% { transform: scale(0.96) rotate(-2deg); opacity: 0.9; }
      100% { transform: scale(1.08) rotate(3deg); opacity: 1; }
    }

    .hero-dessert-caption {
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--color-primary);
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }

    .hero-floating-badge {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -15px;
      right: -10px;
      background: #D79E17;
      color: #231E12;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       3. FEATURED DRINKS & MENU PREVIEW
       ========================================================= */
    .menu-preview-section {
      padding: 6rem 0;
      background-color: var(--color-bg);
    }

    .section-header-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 3rem;
    }

    .signature-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
    }

    .signature-card {
      background-color: var(--color-bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-card-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 1.75rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      position: relative;
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .signature-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      background-color: var(--color-bg-card-hover);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-color: var(--color-primary);
    }

    .card-top {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .card-tag {
      font-size: 0.725rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #231E12;
      background-color: var(--color-primary);
      padding: 0.25rem 0.65rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    }

    .card-price {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--color-text);
    }

    .card-title {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--color-text);
      margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
    }

    .card-desc {
      font-size: 0.925rem;
      color: var(--color-text);
      opacity: 0.85;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      flex-grow: 1;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .card-flavor-note {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #725D2B;
      border-top: 1px dashed rgba(181, 165, 139, 0.6);
      padding-top: 0.85rem;
    }

    /* Menu Interactive Section */
    .menu-tabs-wrapper {
      background-color: var(--color-bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-card-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 2.25rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .menu-tabs-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }

    .menu-tabs-nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    }

    .tab-btn {
      padding: 0.6rem 1.25rem;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      color: var(--color-text);
      background-color: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--color-secondary);
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
    }

    .tab-btn:hover,
    .tab-btn.active {
      background-color: var(--color-primary);
      border-color: var(--color-primary);
      color: #231E12;
    }

    .menu-items-grid {
      display: none;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr));
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    .menu-items-grid.active-tab-panel {
      display: grid;
      animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease;
    }

    @keyframes fadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    .menu-item-row {
      background: var(--color-surface-white);
      padding: 1.25rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid rgba(181, 165, 139, 0.35);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
    }

    .menu-item-row:hover {
      border-color: var(--color-primary);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(59, 51, 31, 0.08);
    }

    .item-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: baseline;
      margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
    }

    .item-name {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--color-text);
    }

    .item-price {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--color-text);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      margin-left: 0.5rem;
    }

    .item-desc {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--color-text);
      opacity: 0.8;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       4. ABOUT / BRAND STORY
       ========================================================= */
    .story-section {
      padding: 6rem 0;
      background-color: #ECE4D3;
      position: relative;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--color-card-border);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-card-border);
    }

    .story-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4rem;
    }

    .story-content {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .story-blurb {
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      line-height: 1.8;
      color: var(--color-text);
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
      position: relative;
      font-style: normal;
    }

    .story-quote-mark {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: 4rem;
      line-height: 1;
      color: var(--color-primary);
      opacity: 0.4;
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: -1rem;
    }

    .founder-signature {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1.25rem;
      padding-top: 1.5rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--color-secondary);
    }

    .founder-avatar {
      width: 58px;
      height: 58px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary), #A67507);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #231E12;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(215, 158, 23, 0.3);
    }

    .founder-details h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--color-text);
    }

    .founder-details p {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: #6C5E3D;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .values-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.25rem;
    }

    .value-card {
      background: var(--color-surface-white);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-card-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
    }

    .value-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--color-primary);
      transform: translateX(6px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .value-card-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .value-icon {
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background-color: var(--color-pill-bg);
      color: var(--color-primary);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1rem;
    }

    .value-card h3 {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      color: var(--color-text);

  <!-- =========================================================
       VANILLA JAVASCRIPT LOGIC
       ========================================================= -->
  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      // 1. Mobile Menu Toggle
      const hamburgerBtn = document.getElementById('hamburgerBtn');
      const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobileMenu');
      const mobileLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link');

      if (hamburgerBtn && mobileMenu) {
        hamburgerBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const isOpen = mobileMenu.classList.toggle('open');
          hamburgerBtn.classList.toggle('active');
          hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
        });

        mobileLinks.forEach(link => {
          link.addEventListener('click', () => {
            mobileMenu.classList.remove('open');
            hamburgerBtn.classList.remove('active');
            hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          });
        });
      }

      // 2. Navbar Scroll Shadow Effect
      const navbar = document.getElementById('navbar');
      window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
        if (window.scrollY > 30) {
          navbar.classList.add('scrolled');
        } else {
          navbar.classList.remove('scrolled');
        }
      });

      // 3. Menu Tabs Switching
      const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn');
      const tabPanels = document.querySelectorAll('.menu-items-grid');

      tabButtons.forEach(button => {
        button.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const targetId = button.getAttribute('data-tab');

          tabButtons.forEach(btn => {
            btn.classList.remove('active');
            btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
          });
          tabPanels.forEach(panel => {
            panel.classList.remove('active-tab-panel');
          });

          button.classList.add('active');
          button.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
          const targetPanel = document.getElementById(targetId);
          if (targetPanel) {
            targetPanel.classList.add('active-tab-panel');
          }
        });
      });

      // 4. Dynamic Live Open / Closed Status & Active Day Highlight
      const statusDot = document.getElementById('statusDot');
      const statusText = document.getElementById('statusText');
      const hoursRows = document.querySelectorAll('.hours-row');

      const now = new Date();
      const currentDay = now.getDay(); // 0 is Sunday, 1 is Monday ...
      const currentHour = now.getHours();

      // Highlight today's row in the hours list
      hoursRows.forEach(row => {
        if (parseInt(row.getAttribute('data-day'), 10) === currentDay) {
          row.classList.add('highlight-day');
          const daySpan = row.querySelector('.hours-day');
          if (daySpan) {
            daySpan.innerHTML += ' <span style="font-size:0.75rem; color:#D79E17;">(Today)</span>';
          }
        }
      });

      // The café is open 11:00 AM (11) until 1:00 AM (01:00)
      // Open hours: (hour >= 11) OR (hour === 0)
      const isOpenNow = (currentHour >= 11 || currentHour === 0);

      if (isOpenNow) {
        statusDot.classList.remove('closed');
        statusText.textContent = 'Open Now • Serving until 1:00 AM Tonight';
      } else {
        statusDot.classList.add('closed');
        statusText.textContent = 'Closed Now • Opens at 11:00 AM Today';
      }

      // 5. Newsletter Submission Handling
      const newsletterForm = document.getElementById('newsletterForm');
      const newsletterEmail = document.getElementById('newsletterEmail');
      const newsletterFeedback = document.getElementById('newsletterFeedback');

      if (newsletterForm && newsletterEmail && newsletterFeedback) {
        newsletterForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          const emailVal = newsletterEmail.value.trim();

          if (!emailVal || !emailVal.includes('@') || !emailVal.includes('.')) {
            newsletterFeedback.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
            newsletterFeedback.className = 'newsletter-feedback error';
            return;
          }

          newsletterFeedback.textContent = 'Thank you! You are on our private guest list.';
          newsletterFeedback.className = 'newsletter-feedback success';
          newsletterEmail.value = '';

          setTimeout(() => {
            newsletterFeedback.textContent = '';
            newsletterFeedback.className = 'newsletter-feedback';
          }, 6000);
        });
      }
    });
  </script>
